verdict.line: You lose if you dump Enrage health into a charged Granite Shield and get poked down by Q/E; you win if you bait the shield off and trade when his cooldowns are open.

brief.thesis: Malphite's kit is built around Granite Shield absorbing your poke and Seismic Shard/Ground Slam chipping you from range, but neither skill stuns or roots, so Sion's 550-range Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun lets you force trades on your terms once his shield is down. This is a 53.1% matchup over 241 games for Sion, not a hard lane — the edge comes from reading the passive, not out-damaging him blind.

theirWindow.what: Don't commit Enrage autos or all-in here — the shield eats a flat chunk of your damage and he trades back safely with Seismic Shard and Ground Slam while you've wasted health for nothing.

yourWindow.when: after he fires Q or E (7-8s CD)
yourWindow.what: Both Seismic Shard and Ground Slam are on 7-8s cooldowns with no other peel, so step in with Q (Cryptic Gaze) to stun, pop W (Death's Caress) shield, and toggle E (Enrage) autos freely until he resets.

powerCurve.note: both tanky, farming, no real poke yet
Q/E poke rotation outranges your melee kit
R (Cannibalism) sustain beats his poke damage
his R threatens roams, your items snowball

start.why: Blunts his Seismic Shard and Ground Slam poke damage directly and the regen lets you hold lane through the level 3-5 window where he's ahead.

boots.why: Carries a higher win rate in this matchup (58.8% over 97 games) and the tenacity cuts the slow from Seismic Shard, which is the only real way he can kite or disengage from your stun.

core.why: Builds the max-health pool that both scales Enrage's damage conversion and outlasts his flat Granite Shield absorb as the game goes on.
Sustain and magic resist directly answer his Seismic Shard and Ground Slam, both of which are magic damage.
Completes the 81.3%-win core path (16 games) and adds more flat damage reduction against his poke-based trading pattern.

situational.when: you're ahead and want more wave clear and sustained auto damage instead of pure tank stats
the game goes long and you need more magic resist and tenacity on top of Hollow Radiance
their team stacks crit or heavy AD carries alongside Malphite
you need an active slow to stick onto a fed AD threat in teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: Every proc heals you and grows max health, which directly offsets the health you spend toggling Enrage into his Granite Shield window and wins the extended trade over time.

summoners.why: Run by 91% of Sion players here at a 51.7% win rate — Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Enrage autos and still answer his Unstoppable Force roams once he hits 6.

playing.title: Shield his Q, not his autos
playing.detail: Pop W (Death's Caress) right as Seismic Shard is about to land so the shield absorbs the poke instead of your health bar.

playing.title: Bait the Granite Shield down first
playing.detail: Take a minion-aggro trade or a single auto before committing Q (Cryptic Gaze) and your full combo — hitting a charged shield wastes your burst.

playing.title: Trade in his 7-8s dead zones
playing.detail: Both Seismic Shard and Ground Slam are on short cooldowns with nothing else to peel — step in the instant either lands to stun and toggle Enrage.

playing.title: Don't feed Enrage into a shielded target
playing.detail: Enrage costs health per attack with no cooldown of its own, so only toggle it on when his passive is down or you're finishing a kill.

playing.title: Save R for sustained fights, not burst
playing.detail: Cannibalism's value is the attack-speed ramp and ally healing over several seconds of attacking, so use it to win extended trades, not as a panic button.

playing.title: Respect his R range from level 6 on
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force has 1000 range and knocks up — don't overextend past your wave once he hits 6, even though its cooldown starts at 130s.

playing.title: Use W's detonation for wave control
playing.detail: Reactivating Death's Caress early to pop the shield clears casters and punishes him for standing in melee range during a push.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning about cooldown windows and the Granite Shield read is my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Use your shield to absorb the damage from his (Q). Use Grasp of the Undying whenever it comes off cooldown to fight him.
